equity_bridge.item: Columbia University patent litigation accrual (probable loss, other long-term liabilities)
equity_bridge.note: 10-K FY2026 Note 18: estimate of probable loss reduced by $354M in Q4 FY2026 to ~$254M after the Federal Circuit remand; unpaid at 2026-10-02 (surety bond posted). Deducted as a debt-like claim not in the flows.

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: FY2027 guidance midpoint ($5.49B on $5.00B FY2026), raised twice during FY2027; the historical CAGRs are not usable as a forward base because both windows contain an acquisition (Avast closed Sep-2022 in FY2023, MoneyLion Apr-2025 in FY2026) and FY2026 carried a 53rd week.
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 5-year CAGR is undefined (FY2021 equity was a $500M deficit after the Broadcom-sale-era distributions) and the 3-year diluted-EPS CAGR is negative only because FY2023 EPS of $2.17 contained a large tax benefit; neither is a signal about the business. Revenue CAGRs (~14-15%) are acquisition-driven: organic Cyber Safety growth has been low-to-mid single digits. Owner-FCF CAGRs are computed on the SBC-and-equity-tax-adjusted series (FY2021 $561M, FY2023 $597M, FY2026 $1,231M); they run slightly above reported-FCF CAGRs because SBC grew slower than cash flow until the FY2026 MoneyLion replacement awards.
historical_growth.notes: Owner FCF history (reported FCF - SBC - equity-award taxes): FY2021 700-81-58=561; FY2022 968-70-15=883; FY2023 751-134-20=597; FY2024 2,044-138-26=1,880 (inflated by a $446M income-taxes-payable swing and $861M other-assets release tied to the IRS settlement); FY2025 1,206-133-26=1,047; FY2026 1,523-237-55=1,231. TTM to 2026-10-02 on the same basis is ~1,487 (OCF 1,780, capex 16, SBC 225, equity taxes 52). All figures are after ~$550-670M/yr of cash interest.

scenario_narratives.base: Gen executes the FY2027 guide (+9.8%, raised twice) and then settles into a two-speed business: the Norton/Avast/LifeLock membership base grows 3-5% on price and bundle upsell while Trust-Based Solutions (identity, MoneyLion, Engine marketplace) grows in the teens before fading, for blended growth gliding from 6.5% to 2.5%. Adjusted EBITDA margin (pre-SBC) edges from 49.5% to 51% as the Fiscal 2027 AI restructuring and MoneyLion cost synergies offset the mix shift toward lower-margin financial wellness. SBC plus equity taxes drift from 5.6% to 4.2% of revenue. Acquired-intangible amortisation runs off, so cash taxes rise toward 25% of a fuller EBIT. Free cash funds the $900M Sep-2027 notes, term-loan amortisation, the $0.50/yr dividend and buybacks that hold the count flat. Value is unlevered FCF less $7.6B net debt and the $254M Columbia accrual, capped at 15x terminal FCF.
scenario_narratives.bull: Cross-sell works: connecting financial accounts to Norton 360 lifts ARPU and retention, Engine by Gen marketplace monetisation scales with the 600+ partner network, and AI scam-protection/agentic-security features create a reason to pay that OS vendors do not match. Growth holds 7-8% for three years and 5-6% through year 6; margin reaches 54% as the data platform is unified and marketing efficiency improves. SBC falls to 3.7%. Terminal growth 3%. If the stock sustains $37.50 before Apr-2027 the 12M CVRs convert into ~7M shares (~1.2%), a small haircut to this case not modelled in the flat count.
scenario_narratives.bear: Structural decline in the core: Apple, Microsoft and Google bundle enough free security and identity features that Cyber Safety renewals slip and pricing power disappears (segment goes to -2 to -3%/yr), while a CFPB or state earned-wage-access ruling forces MoneyLion to reprice Instacash and partners pull marketing budgets. Revenue peaks in FY2029 and drifts down 1%/yr; retention marketing and partner revenue share compress adjusted EBITDA margin to 42%; SBC stays at 5.5% because equity is used to retain talent through the decline. With $8.2B of principal to refinance (springing maturities Jul-2027, Jun-2029, Jul-2030) the equity bears the full compression; a 12x terminal cap reflects what a buyer pays for a shrinking consumer-software franchise.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Unlevered owner-FCF DCF with SBC and equity-award taxes fully expensed, share count held flat (funded by actual buybacks), EBITDA margin normalised for the $354M FY2026 Columbia reversal, acquired-intangible amortisation allowed to run off (raising modelled cash tax), terminal value capped at 15x (12x bear), $7.6B net debt and the $254M Columbia accrual deducted, and a 25/50/25 weighting that leans toward the downside because leverage, OS bundling and fintech regulation are simultaneous risks. The long-term income-taxes payable of $1,625M is flagged, not deducted.
key_risks_to_valuation: Long-term income taxes payable of $1,625M (unrecognised tax benefits, 10-Q 2026-10-02) is not deducted; if settled in full it is ~$2.7/share off every scenario. Gen has a history of both large IRS settlements (FY2024) and favourable releases.

Refinancing: $900M 6.75% notes due Sep-2027 and $5.7B of SOFR-linked term loans; a 100bp SOFR move is ~$57M/yr of interest. The unlevered model does not capture a refinancing failure; the bear weight does.

EBITDA normalisation: the 49.5% anchor removes the $354M reversal and restructuring; if the Instacash loss-on-sale ($205M FY2026) grows faster than Financial Wellness revenue, margin starts lower than modelled.

D&A run-off raises modelled cash tax by ~2pp of revenue by year 10; if Gen keeps acquiring, new amortisation replaces old and GAAP-tax convergence is slower (favourable to FCF), while the unlevered build already ignores the interest tax shield (unfavourable).
CVR dilution of ~7M shares (1.2%) if the stock holds $37.50 for 30 days before 2027-04-17; immaterial to IV but reduces the bull case slightly.
Columbia remand could still produce a loss above the $254M accrual; the 10-K says the excess cannot be estimated.
Historical CAGRs are acquisition-driven; the organic growth rate of the core is low-to-mid single digits and the whole base case rests on Trust-Based Solutions sustaining teens growth through FY2029.

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API at inputs.price_as_of (regular close, Friday 2026-11-06); 52-week range 17.78-31.65.
data_sources.financials: SEC XBRL history via GEN_Metrics.csv (112 periods); anchors from the 10-K for FY2026 (ended 2026-04-03) and the 10-Q for Q2 FY2027 (quarter ended 2026-10-02): income statement, cash flow statement, Note 8 debt table, Note 13/14 tax and EPS notes, Note 18 litigation, MD&A performance metrics (bookings, paid customers, direct/partner revenue).
data_sources.qualitative: GEN_Analysis.json (2026-11-08) for business model, bull/bear axes and FY2027 guidance ($5.465-5.515B revenue, $2.93-2.98 non-GAAP EPS, raised at the 2026-10-28 Q2 release).

inputs.base_revenue_note: FY2026 (53 weeks, ended 2026-04-03) GAAP net revenues, 10-K income statement. The 53rd week added ~$87M (Cyber Safety $56M + Trust-Based $31M, per the Q2 FY2027 10-Q), so FY2027 reported growth is ~1.7pp below underlying.
inputs.share_count_basis: fully diluted at 2026-10-02: 593M shares issued and outstanding per the Q2 FY2027 statement of stockholders' equity plus the ~7M dilutive effect of employee equity awards shown by the quarter's diluted (603M) vs basic (596M) weighted counts. Held FLAT because SBC is fully expensed in the flows (charging both would double-count). The 12M MoneyLion CVRs (each worth $23.00 in Gen stock if the 30-day VWAP reaches $37.50 before 2027-04-17) are excluded: at the trigger price they would add ~7M shares (~1.2%), a bull-case-only dilution noted in the bull narrative.
inputs.net_debt_note: Principal debt $8,185M (6.75% notes due Sep-2027 $900M; Term B due Sep-2029 $2,322M; 7.125% notes due Sep-2030 $600M; Extended Term A due Mar-2031 $2,672M; Incremental Term B due Apr-2032 $741M; 6.25% notes due Apr-2033 $950M) less cash and equivalents $583M, both at 2026-10-02 (10-Q Note 8 and MD&A liquidity). Principal used rather than the $8,116M carrying value because principal is what must be refinanced. $1,495M undrawn revolver. Operating lease liabilities are not added (lease cost stays inside EBITDA, treatment A).
inputs.sbc_source: 10-K FY2026 cash flow statement: stock-based compensation expense $237M (operating add-back) plus tax payments related to vesting of stock units $55M (financing). Gen publishes no combined SBC-plus-equity-tax line in its non-GAAP reconciliation, so the two cash-flow lines are summed per the method. Interest income ($25M FY2026) is NOT stripped: the company is a $7.6B net debtor, so there is no cash pile being double-counted.
inputs.buyback_note: FY2026 repurchases $634M (25M shares) per the 10-K cash flow statement; H1 FY2027 a further $271M (10M shares). Gen is a genuine repurchaser, so the flat share count is funded, not a modelling convention. Dividends ($312M FY2026, $0.125/quarter) are a distribution and are not deducted from owner FCF.
inputs.fiscal_year_end: Friday closest to 31 March (52/53-week year; FY2026 ended 2026-04-03 and had 53 weeks)
inputs.wacc_rationale: USD flows, USD rate build. Risk-free ~4.2% (10y UST, early Nov 2026), ERP 5.0%, equity beta ~1.1 (consumer software unlevered beta ~0.85 relevered at D/E ~0.45) gives a cost of equity ~9.9%. Pre-tax cost of debt ~6.6% (term loans at SOFR + ~2%, senior notes at 6.25-7.125%), ~5.0% after tax. Market-value weights: equity ~$17.9B (600M x 29.79), debt $8.2B, D/V ~31%. WACC = 0.69 x 9.9 + 0.31 x 5.0 = ~8.4%, rounded to 8.5%. The same WACC is used in all three scenarios: leverage, MoneyLion regulatory exposure and OS-bundling risk are charged through the bear-case driver paths and a 25% bear weight, not through a second premium in the discount rate.
inputs.lease_treatment: Treatment A: operating lease cost ($18M/yr non-cash operating lease expense, rent inside opex) is left inside the EBITDA margin, so lease liabilities are NOT added to net debt. Leases are immaterial at ~0.4% of revenue.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF DCF, component build, 10-year horizon (US consumer-software operating company; SKILL.md row 1). Fresh build, no prior DCF or memory entry. EBITDA ANCHOR: FY2026 GAAP operating income $2,120M included a $354M Columbia litigation accrual reversal in G&A; normalised adjusted EBITDA (op income + D&A $493M + SBC $237M + restructuring $35M - $354M reversal) is $2,531M = 50.6% of revenue, and H1 FY2027 on the same basis is $1,337M = 49.4% (op income $950M + D&A $245M + SBC $110M + restructuring $32M). Year-1 adj-EBITDA margin anchored at 49.5%; the margin is PRE-SBC and the sbc_pct_path (incl. equity-award taxes) is charged against it, so owner EBITDA in year 1 is ~43.9%, consistent with H1 FY2027 GAAP EBITDA ex-restructuring 45.4% less 1.6% equity taxes. LEVERED vs UNLEVERED: last_fcf ($1,231M) is the reported, LEVERED owner FCF (after $569M interest paid and $55M equity taxes). The component build is unlevered (interest is not deducted; net debt is subtracted at the end), so year-1 owner FCF of ~$1.97B exceeds last_fcf by roughly the after-tax interest ($427M) plus the reversal of FY2026 working-capital outflows ($364M other liabilities, $96M taxes payable); this is expected, not a margin error. D&A: $477M of the $493M FY2026 D&A is amortisation of acquired intangibles (Avast FY2023, MoneyLion FY2026) which runs off over the horizon; da_pct_path falls 9% -> 1.5%, and because the model taxes EBIT after D&A, cash tax rises from ~8.9% to ~11% of revenue by year 10 as the amortisation shield disappears, roughly the size of the interest tax shield the unlevered build ignores. Capex is tiny ($22M FY2026, 0.4%), held at 0.5%. WORKING CAPITAL: contract liabilities ($1.9B, ~38% of revenue) grow with bookings, but MoneyLion's Instacash receivables and notes receivable consume cash on growth; net capture set at 10% of the revenue change in base. The $205M FY2026 'loss on sale of Instacash advances' is a real funding cost and is correctly left inside the EBITDA margin (its non-cash add-back is offset by the held-for-sale working-capital line). EQUITY BRIDGE: the remaining Columbia patent accrual ($254M, other long-term liabilities, Federal Circuit remand pending) is deducted as a debt-like item. NOT deducted but flagged: long-term income taxes payable $1,625M at 2026-10-02 (unrecognised tax benefits, indefinite timing; ~$2.7/share if paid in full). SEASONALITY/VINTAGE: valuation is six months into FY2027; FY2027 is discounted as a full year 1, slightly conservative. TAX: GAAP ETR 36% FY2026 / 29% H1 FY2027 vs cash taxes $445M FY2026 (26% of modelled unlevered EBIT); cash_tax_rate_path 24% -> 25% (US federal 21% + state, Irish/Czech operations lower).

bear.growth_note: Year 1 at the bottom of guidance (+9.3%, H1 already booked); from FY2028 Cyber Safety turns to low-single-digit decline as Apple/Microsoft/Google bundling and auto-renewal rules bite, and an earned-wage-access/CFPB action stalls MoneyLion. Revenue drifts -1%/yr from year 5; margin compresses ~7pp on retention marketing and partner revenue share; 12x cap for a shrinking franchise.

base.growth_note: Year 1 = FY2027 guidance midpoint (+9.8%; H1 actual +9.2% reported, ~+13% ex the 53rd week; Q2 +12.2%). FY2028 onward blends Cyber Safety at 3-5% (Q2 FY2027 +5%) with Trust-Based Solutions decelerating from +26% as MoneyLion laps; glides to 2.5% by year 10.
base.margin_note: Adjusted EBITDA is pre-SBC. 49.5% year-1 anchor sits between normalised FY2026 (50.6%) and H1 FY2027 (49.4%); +1.5pp over ten years from the Fiscal 2027 restructuring (~$50M), AI-driven cost take-out and MoneyLion revenue synergies, partly offset by mix shift toward lower-margin Trust-Based Solutions (segment margin ~30% vs Cyber Safety ~62%).
base.sbc_note: Incl. equity-award taxes. FY2026 5.8% (inflated by MoneyLion replacement awards), H1 FY2027 5.7%; pre-MoneyLion run-rate was ~4%. Glides 5.6% -> 4.2%.
base.da_note: Acquired-intangible amortisation ($477M of $493M FY2026) runs off; D&A converges toward depreciation plus a thin layer of future tuck-in amortisation. Only the tax shield matters for FCF.
base.terminal_note: 15x cap (not 20x) for a low-single-digit-growth, 3x-levered consumer software franchise facing OS-vendor bundling; Gordon at 8.5%/2.5% is 17.1x, so the cap binds.

bull.growth_note: Year 1 at the top of guidance (+10.3%); cross-sell of financial wellness into the ~500M-user base lifts ARPU and retention so Cyber Safety holds mid-single digits while Trust-Based Solutions compounds in the teens for several years.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 15x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% house default to 25% because three independent downside forces are live at once: 3x net leverage with $900M due Sep-2027 and springing maturities on the Term A/revolver, structural OS-vendor bundling in the core consumer security category, and consumer-finance regulatory exposure (CFPB, state EWA licensing) that is new to Gen's risk profile since MoneyLion. Bull cut to 25% because it needs cross-sell, marketplace monetisation and AI differentiation all to work. Base 50%: the FY2027 guide is largely delivered (H1 booked) and the subscription base has proven sticky through FY2024-FY2026.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
